concept.title: Assessments
concept.shortdesc: Having or carrying out an assessment of a person's needs, abilities or skills, such as an initial, clinical, falls, skills or driving assessment.

section.title: Evidence and status

strow.stentry: Draft, not reviewed, and unconfirmed: the group did not re-form reliably (stability 0.48). It is named only because a need points at it.

Mixed: the group holds more than one kind of service. It would split into health and clinical assessments (clinical, falls, behaviour, driving ability) and education or skills assessments (skills, study needs, initial assessment).
Did not recur reliably when the data was resampled; it is named only because a need points at it, so treat the name as a proposal and the group as unconfirmed.

section.p: Identifier in this run: svc-157. Identifiers are cluster numbers of one run and change whenever the clustering is re-run; they are not stable ids.
